units.title: UNIT I PHYSIOLOGY AND TRANSDUCERS
topics: Cell and its structure – Resting and Action Potential – Nervous system: Functional organisation of the nervous system – Structure of nervous system
neurons - synapse – transmitters and neural communication – Cardiovascular system – respiratory system – Basic components of a biomedical system - Transducers – selection criteria – Piezo-electric
ultrasonic transducers - Temperature measurements - Fibre optic temperature sensors

units.title: UNIT II ELECTRO – PHYSIOLOGICAL
topics: MEASUREMENTS Electrodes –Limb electrodes –floating electrodes – pregelled disposable electrodes - Micro
needle and surface electrodes – Amplifiers: Preamplifiers
ECG – EEG – EMG – ERG – Lead systems and recording methods – Typical waveforms
Electrical safety in medical environment: shock hazards – leakage current-Instruments for checking safety parameters of biomedical equipments

units.title: UNIT III NON-ELECTRICAL PARAMETER
topics: MEASUREMENTS Measurement of blood pressure – Cardiac output – Heart rate – Heart sound – Pulmonary function measurements – spirometer – Photo Plethysmography
Body Plethysmography – Blood Gas analysers : pH of blood –measurement of blood pCO2, pO2, finger-tip oxymeter - ESR, GSR measurements

units.title: UNIT IV MEDICAL IMAGING
topics: Radio graphic and fluoroscopic techniques – Computer tomography – MRI – Ultrasonography – Endoscopy – Thermography – Different types of biotelemetry systems and patient monitoring – Introduction to Biometric systems

units.title: UNIT V ASSISTING AND THERAPEUTIC EQUIPMENTS
topics: Pacemakers – Defibrillators – Ventilators – Nerve and muscle stimulators – Diathermy – Heart-Lung machine – Audio meters – Dialysers – Lithotripsy
